OpenStreetMap exports for use in GIS applications.

This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching: amenity IN ('kindergarten', 'school', 'college', 'university','language_school') OR office='educational_institution'

Features may have these attributes: name, amenity, isced:level, capacity
